Author: r1kai

Description
[/b][/size]The mod is meant for use on a fresh save.

It gives you an Elf Dagger on the 2nd Day of Spring, in Year 1 and a chest that the dagger was stored in to help make early game combat a bit less stressful.

This mod is a continuation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4151]Grandfather's Gift Remade[/url] with direct permission from Pepoluan.

Grandfather's gift was directly inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/985]Grandfather's Gift[/url], but since that mod is not open source, Pepoluan had to totally remake it from scratch.

Only the ideas remain; the code, the logic, even the words, everything started in Pepoluan's diabolical mind (with great help from friends at [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/forums/mods.215/]The Stardew Valley Forums[/url]).

rikai's ideas, however, were shaped by the wonderful people in the mods channels of the [url=https://discord.com/invite/stardewvalley]Stardew Valley Discord[/url] and the depths of his insanity.

[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.5 (latest)
[*]SMAPI 3.0.0 or newer
[/list]
[b][size=4]Configuration[/size][/b]
Some [i]config.json[/i] knobs to fine-tune the experience:
[list]
[*][b]traceLogging[/b] - Set to [i]false [/i]if you think the TRACE logging is too chatty, making it difficult to troubleshoot other mods.
[*][b]directToChest[/b] - If [i]false[/i] (default), the weapon will go into inventory, and only placed in the chest if the inventory is full.
[*][b]triggerDay[/b] - The day when the mod will trigger. Limited to `2<=day<=28`. Season & year are locked to "spring" and 1, respectively.
[*][b]weaponStats[/b] - You can modify the Elf Dagger stats here. Won't affect other weapons and/or events because, by default, you can NOT get the Elf Dagger.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Internationalization [/b][/size]
Yes, however, files are not there yet. Feel free to write a translation of the default.json in the i18n directory and submit a pull request.

Also happy to accept pull requests that flesh out the implementation.

[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]No known conflicts.
[/list]
[size=4][b]To Do / Future Plans?[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]More polish.
[*]Instead of directly giving a chest, put a "package" with custom interaction (similar to the "starter parsnip" gift Lewis gives)
[*]Colorificize the chest
[*]Custom sprite for the Elf Dagger
[*]Additional season support
[*]And finally, if there's interest, additional gifts! (I'll need the When + Where + What)
[/list]
[size=4][b]Discussion[/b][/size]
Ping me (@rikai) on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/stardewvalley]Stardew Valley Discord[/url] in one of the modding channels!

Downloads.Description:
Updated for SMAPI 4.0 and Stardew Valley 1.6.

Fixes a bug in the initial 1.6 release that did not correctly apply stats to the weapon.
